requirement: P7 鈥?Diagnostics / Doctor (each check fault-isolated; a doctor failure must not affect Boss startup)
summary: Added Boss Doctor: 25 fault-isolated probes across the eleven areas the plan names (runtime, dependency, filesystem, browser, network, account, IPC, fleet, knowledge, learning, build/runtime compatibility), each reporting what it actually observed, what a healthy machine would show, and a remedy when it is not ready. Every probe runs through a wrapper that converts a throw into that check's failure, so one broken probe cannot stop the others and the doctor never throws. The verdict is advisory by construction: it has no stop value and nothing in Boss consults it, so a broken probe or a missing report can never prevent startup.
implementation: src/shared/doctor.ts (pure): DOCTOR_AREAS and DOCTOR_STATUSES (READY/DEGRADED/FAIL/SKIPPED 鈥?deliberately no STOP); DoctorCheck with observed/expected/reason/remedy; runProbe wrapping every probe so a throw becomes one check's FAIL; skippedCheck for 'cannot evaluate here' as distinct from failure; doctorVerdict blocking only on runtime/filesystem/dependency failures and never on a skipped check; summarizeDoctor; buildDoctorReport carrying an optional doctorFailure without losing the checks; renderDoctorReport
